en_title: Our Big Interview With Ocarina of Time Producers Eiji Aonuma and Hidemaro Fujibayashi
cn_title: 我们对《塞尔达传说 时之笛》制作人青沼英二和藤林秀麿的长篇采访
opus_summary: 青沼英二与藤林秀麿在《塞尔达传说 时之笛》重制版发售前接受采访，谈及让年轻开发者熟悉并重新诠释原作、系列中探索与发现的核心，以及重制版对镜头和跳跃操作的调整。青沼英二表示，他认为重制版的讨论是在《王国之泪》开发结束后展开的。

paragraphs.en: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake is framed as a legend retold. It opens on a tapestry depicting Hyrule’s people and places, as a narrator reflects on Link’s journey like it’s a valuable story worth passing down. For Zelda producers Eiji Aonuma and Hidemaro Fujibayashi, a desire to pass the original game down to a younger group of Zelda developers is one of the main reasons this remake exists:
paragraphs.cn: 《塞尔达传说 时之笛》重制版以重述传说的形式呈现。游戏开篇是一幅描绘海拉鲁人物与场所的挂毯，旁白回顾林克的旅程，仿佛那是一个值得流传下去的宝贵故事。对《塞尔达传说》制作人青沼英二和藤林秀麿来说，希望将原作传给更年轻的一批《塞尔达传说》开发者，是这款重制版诞生的主要原因之一：

paragraphs.en: “There are much younger developers who are working on this game, and I do think this is a really valuable experience for them to familiarize themselves first with the original Ocarina of Time and then have their own reinterpretation of it,” Aonuma said. “And to have those conversations throughout the course of development that may aid them in future projects as well.”
paragraphs.cn: 「有年轻得多的开发者参与这款游戏的制作，我确实认为，让他们先熟悉原版《塞尔达传说 时之笛》，然后对它进行自己的重新诠释，是一次非常宝贵的经历，」青沼说，「在开发过程中进行这些讨论，也可能对他们未来的项目有所帮助。」

paragraphs.en: This is just one way the pair is reflecting on this franchise they’ve spent decades working on. I spoke to Aonuma and Fujibayashi for nearly an hour ahead of the release of Ocarina of Time, and we discussed the elements that make a Zelda game, how real-world inspirations and expertise play into game development at Nintendo, and their strongest memories and reflections as the Zelda franchise celebrates its 40th anniversary. Read on for my full conversation, including one of Aonuma’s key memories with Zelda creator Shigeru Miyamoto: "Hey, Mr. Aonuma, you know you can't really cut a wooden crate with a sword, right?"
paragraphs.cn: 这只是两人回顾这个他们已为之工作数十年的系列的一种方式。在《塞尔达传说 时之笛》发售前，我与青沼和藤林交谈了近一个小时，讨论了构成《塞尔达传说》游戏的要素、现实世界的灵感与专业知识如何影响任天堂的游戏开发，以及在《塞尔达传说》系列迎来40周年之际，他们最深刻的回忆与感想。以下是完整对话，其中包括青沼与《塞尔达传说》创作者宫本茂之间一段重要的回忆：「嘿，青沼先生，你知道现实中用剑是劈不开木箱的吧？」

paragraphs.en: IGN: It is great to meet you both. I'd like to start by congratulating you on tonight's launch of the Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time, as well as the 40th anniversary of The Legend of Zelda.
paragraphs.cn: IGN：很高兴见到两位。首先祝贺《塞尔达传说 时之笛》今晚发售，也祝贺《塞尔达传说》迎来40周年。

paragraphs.en: IGN: The opening cutscene of Ocarina of Time's remake and its tapestry present this remake as a legend being passed down. I can't help but think of the parallels with its development. Mr. Aonuma, you said that you wanted your team to understand the significance of Ocarina of Time. In a way, you're passing down a legend of your own, and I'm wondering if this connection was on your mind throughout development.
paragraphs.cn: IGN：《塞尔达传说 时之笛》重制版的开场过场动画及其中的挂毯，让这款重制版呈现为一个流传下来的传说。我不禁想到这与游戏开发过程之间的相似之处。青沼先生，你曾说希望团队理解《塞尔达传说 时之笛》的意义。从某种程度上说，你也在传承属于自己的传说，我想知道，在整个开发过程中，你是否想过这种联系。

paragraphs.en: Eiji Aonuma: So the specific cutscene with the tapestry was not necessarily something that I had created with that in mind in terms of handing down a legacy, as you say. That was something that developers who were working more directly on the game contributed to. But for me, certainly as you mentioned, there are much younger developers who are working on this game, and I do think this is a really valuable experience for them to familiarize themselves first with the original Ocarina of Time and then have their own reinterpretation of it. And to have those conversations throughout the course of development that may aid them in future projects as well.
paragraphs.cn: 青沼英二：关于那段出现挂毯的过场动画，我创作它时不一定像你说的那样考虑到了传承。那是由更直接参与游戏制作的开发者贡献的。不过，对我来说，正如你所说，确实有年轻得多的开发者参与这款游戏的制作，我认为让他们先熟悉原版《塞尔达传说 时之笛》，然后对它进行自己的重新诠释，是一次非常宝贵的经历。在开发过程中进行这些讨论，也可能对他们未来的项目有所帮助。

paragraphs.en: IGN: I'd like to ask about that more because one of my takeaways from this game is how much value I find in the traditional 3D Zelda formula, and you’ve said newer developers understanding the structure is one of the purposes of this remake. But it's also caused you both to revisit this traditional Zelda formula after several years away. Revisiting it with fresh eyes, what positive aspects of this more linear type of 3D Zelda have stuck out the most?
paragraphs.cn: IGN：我想进一步问问这个问题，因为我从这款游戏中获得的一个感受是，传统3D《塞尔达传说》模式有着很高的价值。你也说过，让较新的开发者理解这种结构是这款重制版的目的之一。但这也让两位在离开数年后重新审视了这种传统的《塞尔达传说》模式。以全新的眼光重新审视时，这种更线性的3D《塞尔达传说》有哪些优点最为突出？

paragraphs.en: Hidemaro Fujibayashi: As you mentioned, Ocarina of Time perhaps could be described as simpler. And going back to Zelda as a whole, regardless of whether it's an old Zelda game like the initial original Zelda or newer ones, I think the core of what makes a Zelda game, from my experience and thinking, is that it's the combination of exploration and discovery. And that's something that has been with the Zelda series, starting from the very first Zelda game all the way to recent games like Tears of the Kingdom. And I think that's a common through line. And even as we’ve gotten into newer games that have the open-air gameplay style, it becomes a little bit more complex. But as we return to a more focused 3D Zelda experience, as you mentioned, it's kind of given us an opportunity to bring the comforts and the play styles of the modern games.
paragraphs.cn: 藤林秀麿：正如你所说，《塞尔达传说 时之笛》或许可以说更简单一些。再看整个《塞尔达传说》系列，无论是最初的《塞尔达传说》这样的老游戏，还是较新的作品，根据我的经验和想法，我认为构成《塞尔达传说》游戏的核心是探索与发现的结合。从第一款《塞尔达传说》游戏到近期的《王国之泪》等作品，这一点始终伴随着整个系列。我认为这是贯穿其中的共同主线。即使到了采用开放式玩法的较新作品，这一点变得稍微复杂了一些，但正如你所说，当我们回归一种更加集中的3D《塞尔达传说》体验时，这也给了我们机会，将现代游戏的便利性和游玩方式带进来。

paragraphs.en: For example, having a second control analog stick so that you can control the camera. That really eases the experience of gameplay so that coming back to a more straightforward, focused experience really allows the player to focus on the core aspect of Zelda, which, again, is exploration and discovery. And so there's almost this multiplicative gameplay that allows you to dive even deeper into the idea of exploration, discovery. And that's something that I really felt like I kind of reconfirmed within myself that that is really what makes a Zelda game a Zelda game.
paragraphs.cn: 例如，有了第二个控制摇杆，就可以控制视角。这确实让游玩体验变得更加轻松，因此回到一种更直接、更集中的体验时，玩家就能真正专注于《塞尔达传说》的核心，也就是探索与发现。这几乎带来了一种倍增的玩法效果，让你能够更深入地体验探索与发现。我觉得自己也借此再次确认，这确实是让《塞尔达传说》游戏成为《塞尔达传说》游戏的东西。

paragraphs.en: IGN: I'd love to know when this project started development. Mr. Aonuma, you've mentioned that this was a great way to celebrate Zelda's 40th anniversary. I'm wondering when the idea came up and if it was before or after Tears of the Kingdom was released.
paragraphs.cn: IGN：我很想知道这个项目是什么时候开始开发的。青沼先生，你曾提到这是庆祝《塞尔达传说》40周年的好方式。我想知道这个想法是什么时候出现的，是在《王国之泪》发售之前还是之后。

paragraphs.en: Aonuma: It's hard to say exactly when the decision came about to remake Ocarina of Time in this way. I do believe it was after the Tears of Kingdom development had ended, we started to see staff being released to other projects that we were talking about the 40th anniversary timing coming up, and what would be best to celebrate an anniversary like this. So as we were discussing it and looking back over the Zelda franchise through the years, we talked about Ocarina of Time being a really good starting point for a lot of people who have played the franchise, and my professional starting point with the series as well. And I was really curious to see how the younger generation of developers at Nintendo would interpret a game like this for a new generation, for new players. So it's a little hard to nail down the exact timing because there were so many steps along the way, but I do believe it was after the development of Tears of the Kingdom had finished.
paragraphs.cn: 青沼：很难确切地说出是什么时候决定以这种方式重制《塞尔达传说 时之笛》的。我记得是在《王国之泪》开发结束后，我们开始看到员工转去其他项目，当时我们谈到了即将到来的40周年，以及用什么方式庆祝这样的周年纪念最合适。在讨论并回顾《塞尔达传说》系列这些年来的历程时，我们谈到《塞尔达传说 时之笛》对许多玩过这个系列的人来说是一个很好的起点，也是我职业生涯中参与这个系列的起点。我也非常好奇任天堂年轻一代的开发者会如何为新一代、新玩家诠释这样一款游戏。由于整个过程中经历了许多步骤，所以很难确定确切的时间，但我认为是在《王国之泪》开发完成之后。

paragraphs.en: IGN: Mr. Fujibayashi, I noticed this was your first time serving as producer on a Zelda game after directing the last few. What was that transition like for you? Was it difficult to take a step back in any specific situations?
paragraphs.cn: IGN：藤林先生，我注意到，在执导了前几款《塞尔达传说》游戏后，这是你第一次担任该系列游戏的制作人。这种转变对你来说是怎样的？在某些具体情况下，退居幕后是否很困难？

paragraphs.en: Fujibayashi: Even though my role on this title has been producer, I feel like my producer role has been relatively close to the front lines of development. But in terms of maybe a challenge that I faced was, because we now have a younger staff that's working with us, when I'm discussing things like what makes a Zelda or when I'm trying to provide advice or guidance, we have such a vast range of ages in our team. And some of the language we use or some of the way we communicate is a little bit different. So I found myself needing to adjust and recognize if this person has been involved with the series for a long time or if this person is new to the series. And adjusting the way I provide advice or, say, be involved with ideations with those people, I really felt like I had to kind of pull out my wisdom to make sure that the communication works for the person that I'm speaking to.
paragraphs.cn: 藤林：虽然我在这部作品中的角色是制作人，但我觉得自己作为制作人还是比较贴近开发一线的。至于我面临的一个挑战，可能是因为现在有更年轻的员工与我们共事，当我讨论什么构成了《塞尔达传说》，或是试图提供建议、指导时，我们团队成员的年龄跨度非常大。我们使用的一些语言或沟通方式也略有不同。因此我发现自己需要作出调整，弄清楚对方是参与这个系列很久了，还是刚刚接触这个系列。在调整自己提供建议或参与这些人的构思过程的方式时，我确实觉得自己必须拿出智慧，确保沟通方式适合与我交谈的人。

paragraphs.en: IGN: I've finished Ocarina of Time on Switch 2, and I really loved it. What struck me was the intertwining of these two eras that you've mentioned of modern presentation and controls through an old-school Zelda world. And I found this overlapping muscle memory of, originally I would expect Link to auto jump and he didn't and I fell. Or, I thought I could climb a rock and I couldn’t. My brain was pulling from Breath of the Wild and pulling from the original Ocarina of Time. What's something that sticks out to you about blending these two eras of Zelda together that makes this remake special?
paragraphs.cn: IGN：我在Switch 2上通关了《塞尔达传说 时之笛》，非常喜欢。令我印象深刻的是你们提到的两个时代的交织：在一个传统的《塞尔达传说》世界中融入现代的呈现方式和操作。我发现自己的肌肉记忆出现了重叠：起初我以为林克会自动跳跃，结果他没有跳，我就掉了下去。或者，我以为自己能爬上一块岩石，结果却不能。我的大脑既在调用《旷野之息》的经验，也在调用原版《塞尔达传说 时之笛》的经验。在将《塞尔达传说》的这两个时代融合的过程中，有什么让你们印象深刻、又让这款重制版变得特别的地方？

paragraphs.en: Aonuma: There were certainly a lot of moments in development where our younger developers on the staff were considering how to familiarize and reinterpret the original Ocarina of Time. And we didn't tell them what to do in terms of “change this or don't change that,” but rather they would come to the experience and try to feel a natural need for something. And I think two examples are both shifting to a manual camera control, and an auto jump system, where they decided that it was justified to make a change. Now, of course, in some cases, this might mean that you're adding additional review that's necessary because you have to control player access if they can jump absolutely anywhere. But I do believe that it adds a greater feeling of freedom compared to the original jump system in the game. And I hope that that is something players find to be a really good fit. I know that if they are more recent Zelda players who have a lot of experience with Tears of the Kingdom and Breath of the Wild, that's perhaps going to feel like a more natural choice for them.
paragraphs.cn: 青沼：在开发过程中，年轻的开发者确实有很多时候在思考如何熟悉并重新诠释原版《塞尔达传说 时之笛》。我们没有告诉他们「改变这个」或「不要改变那个」，而是让他们亲自体验，尝试感受是否自然地产生了某种需求。我认为其中两个例子是转向手动视角控制，以及自动跳跃系统；他们认为这些地方有理由作出改变。当然，在某些情况下，这可能意味着需要进行额外的审查，因为如果玩家可以在任何地方跳跃，就必须控制他们能够到达的区域。但我认为，与游戏原本的跳跃系统相比，这确实增加了自由感。我希望玩家会觉得这非常合适。我知道，对于玩过很多《王国之泪》和《旷野之息》、较晚接触《塞尔达传说》的玩家来说，这或许会是一个更自然的选择。

paragraphs.en: In the end, those decisions around manual camera and freedom of jumping, I think bring a certain freshness to the remake while still maintaining a lot of the feel of the original. So I hope that both returning players like yourself who are very familiar with the original as well as completely new players are going to find something fresh or invigorating about that experience. But certainly I had a few moments where I fell into some deep pits myself, so don't worry. [Laughs]
paragraphs.cn: 最终，我认为有关手动视角和自由跳跃的这些决定，在保留原作许多感觉的同时，也为重制版带来了一定的新鲜感。所以我希望，无论是像你这样非常熟悉原作的回归玩家，还是完全的新玩家，都能在这种体验中发现新鲜或令人振奋的东西。不过我自己确实也有几次掉进了深坑，所以不用担心。（笑）

paragraphs.en: IGN: [Laughs] I was admiring the new motion aiming, which feels great. And then I walked right off a bridge. So you've said that you left it to the team to make any changes they felt were necessary. Was there anything from the original Ocarina of Time that was untouchable and had to stay the same?
paragraphs.cn: IGN：（笑）我当时正在欣赏新的体感瞄准功能，感觉非常棒。然后我就径直从桥上走了下去。你说过，你让团队自行作出他们认为必要的任何改动。原版《塞尔达传说 时之笛》中有什么是不能碰、必须保持不变的吗？

paragraphs.en: Fujibayashi: There isn't one specific “this” or one specific “that” we wanted to change, but as we started up on the development of this game, there was obviously the younger staff that were basically the directors for the game. One thing we made sure we did right off the bat is really clearly define what we're going to change, what we're not going to change. And when it comes to what we wanted to change, we wanted to encourage the team to really leverage the capabilities of the Nintendo Switch 2 hardware. That leads to things like the ability to control the camera or the ability to jump anywhere. It also goes into things like renewing the graphics in its entirety and increasing the quality of the sound. Like for example, in this title, all of the background music is in 5.1 channel surround sound.
paragraphs.cn: 藤林：我们并不是想改变某个具体的「这个」或「那个」，但在开始开发这款游戏时，显然有一些年轻员工基本上担任着游戏的总监。我们一开始就确保做的一件事，是非常明确地界定哪些要改变，哪些不改变。至于我们想改变的部分，我们希望鼓励团队充分利用Switch 2硬件的性能。这带来了控制视角或在任何地方跳跃等功能，也包括全面更新画面和提升音质。比如，在这部作品中，所有背景音乐都是5.1声道环绕声。

paragraphs.en: So if you listen to the game with headphones on, it really provides an immersive experience. And then going to the things that we weren't going to change, we really thought about, “Okay, what was it that the original Ocarina of Time development team wanted to convey? What's the experience that they wanted to convey through this game?” And that's what we focused on as something that we want to convey as is. And those are the two kind of guiding principles as we began development.
paragraphs.cn: 所以如果戴着耳机听游戏声音，确实能获得沉浸式体验。至于我们不打算改变的东西，我们认真思考了：「原版《塞尔达传说 时之笛》的开发团队想要传达什么？他们想通过这款游戏传达怎样的体验？」我们将其作为希望原样传达的东西来关注。这就是我们开始开发时的两条指导原则。

paragraphs.en: IGN: So Mr. Aonuma, you've mentioned that you would hold lectures along the way during this game's development. What's an example of what those lectures would be about? And were these scheduled or were these spontaneous talks that you had with the team?
paragraphs.cn: IGN：青沼先生，你提到在这款游戏的开发过程中会举办讲座。能否举个例子，说明这些讲座会涉及什么内容？这些是事先安排好的，还是你与团队自发进行的谈话？

paragraphs.en: Aonuma: So I would say these were less teaching lectures and more discussions where I was really asking them how they felt playing the original, how they were interpreting it. And that led to so many moments where I would see how they were interacting with it and say, “Oh, if you feel that way, then feel free to suggest a change in that area that would address the thing that you're seeing.” So I didn't want anyone to be too conscious of rules like I was laying down the law in that sort of sense. Most of these conversations I would say were probably with the directors and it was often a matter of like, “So I understand how you feel playing the original. Is that something that you would want to change?” And sometimes they were the ones who would come back and say, “No, I don't want to change it.” I feel like we had a repetition of that kind of series of conversations over the course of the project.
paragraphs.cn: 青沼：我会说，与其说是教学讲座，不如说是讨论，我会认真询问他们玩原作时感觉如何，以及他们如何理解它。这让很多时候我看到他们如何与游戏互动后，会说：「哦，如果你有这样的感觉，那就尽管提出对那个地方的改动建议，来解决你看到的问题。」所以我不希望任何人过于在意规则，觉得我是在那种意义上发号施令。我想这些对话大多是与总监们进行的，往往会像这样：「我明白你玩原作时的感受了。这是你想改变的东西吗？」有时他们反而会回答：「不，我不想改变它。」我觉得在整个项目过程中，我们反复进行过一系列这样的对话。

paragraphs.en: IGN: Was there a specific moment where a younger team member approached you with something about the original Ocarina of Time that made you think about it in a new way?
paragraphs.cn: IGN：有没有某个具体时刻，一位年轻团队成员就原版《塞尔达传说 时之笛》的某个方面来找你，让你以新的方式思考了它？

paragraphs.en: Aonuma: I think for me, something that stood out about a lot of these conversations with these younger developers about how they were interpreting the original game, is they would sometimes come to me and say, "Okay, I can tell that this aspect is really important." And they would describe something that hadn't necessarily been part of our thinking or our intent at the time. So in my mind I'm thinking, "Oh no, it's not really important in terms of an intentional thing that we were going for." But because they had that reaction, because they had that feeling, that's what was important. And so, in the moment, I can't say, "Oh no, that wasn't important." I listen to them and I say, "Okay, I see how that was important to you and I see which direction it's leading you to want to go and looking for a way to support the important part."
paragraphs.cn: 青沼：对我来说，在与这些年轻开发者讨论他们如何理解原作的许多对话中，有一点很突出：他们有时会来找我说：「我能看出这个方面真的很重要。」然后他们描述的东西不一定是我们当时考虑过的，或是我们当时的意图。所以我心里会想：「哦，不，从我们有意追求的东西来说，那其实并不重要。」但因为他们有那样的反应、有那样的感受，那才是重要的。因此，在那一刻，我不能说：「哦，不，那并不重要。」我会听他们说，然后说：「好，我明白这对你来说为什么重要，也明白它引导你想往哪个方向走」，并寻找支持重要部分的方法。

paragraphs.en: IGN: Is there a specific example of that interaction that sticks out the most?
paragraphs.cn: IGN：这种交流有没有哪个具体例子最让你印象深刻？

paragraphs.en: Fujibayashi: So there's actually a million of those, probably way more than you would imagine. So it's really hard to pick out one. Nothing really stands out as the one.
paragraphs.cn: 藤林：这样的例子其实有一百万个，可能远远超出你的想象。所以真的很难挑出一个。没有哪个特别突出，能成为那个例子。

paragraphs.en: Aonuma: I agree. There's probably too many of those kinds of incidents to pick one and really elevate that. But I will say that sort of as a category of this kind of interaction, something that we saw a lot in our conversations with younger developers as they were interpreting the original is a discussion of how to balance the amount of imagination that you are asking the player to bring to the gameplay experience, the amount of problem solving you want to allow them to do, that's really deeply affected by the information gap you leave. And so we would have these level setting conversations of, “Okay, if you do too much here, you're actually providing so much information to the player that they're not going to make that jump and feel the satisfaction of it.” So there was a lot of balancing around how to leave exactly the right kind of gap for them to have a satisfying experience.
paragraphs.cn: 青沼：我同意。这类事情可能太多了，很难挑出一个来特别强调。不过，如果说这类交流中的一种情况，我们在与年轻开发者讨论他们对原作的理解时，经常会讨论如何平衡希望玩家在游玩体验中发挥多少想象力，以及希望让他们解决多少问题；这会受到你留下的信息空缺的深刻影响。因此我们会进行这样的基准讨论：「如果你在这里做得太多，实际上就是给玩家提供了过多信息，他们就不会自己迈出那一步，也不会感受到其中的满足感。」所以我们花了很多精力进行平衡，考虑如何留下恰到好处的空缺，让他们获得令人满足的体验。

paragraphs.en: IGN: Mr. Fujibayashi, you said one of the things that makes Nintendo special is developers who pull from their own expertise outside of video games. And I really love that, I find that inspiring. And I loved hearing that the developers experimented with fabric and thread when designing the clothes in the remake. What's a real world hobby, passion, or interest of yours that has influenced the Zelda series?
paragraphs.cn: IGN：藤林先生，你说过任天堂的特别之处之一，是开发者会借鉴自己在电子游戏以外的专业知识。我非常喜欢这一点，觉得很受启发。听说开发者在设计重制版中的服装时尝试了布料和线，我也很喜欢这一点。你在现实生活中有什么爱好、热情或兴趣影响了《塞尔达传说》系列？

paragraphs.en: Fujibayashi: Because my involvement with the Ocarina of Time remake was not as a director, there's nothing that directly impacted this game. But when it goes back to things like Breath of the Wild or Tears of the Kingdom, when I was directing the game, things like the kind of food that we put into the game or a lot of the survival aspects of those two games, I think may have took some inspiration from the fact that I grew up on the countryside, so playing around in the mountains, playing around the rivers, those kinds of very basic things that probably all people have experienced to some extent. I think that probably has impacted the way I approach some of the aspects of those games.
paragraphs.cn: 藤林：因为我参与《塞尔达传说 时之笛》重制版时并不是总监，所以没有什么直接影响到这款游戏。但回到《旷野之息》或《王国之泪》这样的作品，当我执导游戏时，我们放进游戏里的食物种类，或是那两款游戏中的许多生存要素，我想可能从我在乡下长大的经历中获得了一些灵感，比如在山里玩、在河边玩，这些大概所有人都在某种程度上经历过的非常基本的事情。我认为这可能影响了我处理那些游戏某些方面的方式。

paragraphs.en: And I spoke about myself, but for this title, some of the designers, for example, as you mentioned, would go out into the real world to experience some of the fabric they might want to recreate in the game, or they might go check out some rocks outside in the real world to really create a world that seems like it actually exists. Those are things that I think, as you mentioned, are what makes Nintendo developers special, and what you said really holds true for this title as well.
paragraphs.cn: 刚才说的是我自己，但对于这部作品，例如正如你提到的，一些设计师会到现实世界中去体验他们可能想在游戏中重现的布料，或者到外面的现实世界中观察一些岩石，以真正创造出一个看似真实存在的世界。我认为，正如你所说，这些事情正是任天堂开发者的特别之处，你说的这一点对这部作品也确实适用。

paragraphs.en: Aonuma: One example of this that I was particularly interested in was the way that the animation staff approached recreating the movements of playing the Ocarina itself. They were studying actual people playing and in some cases, were an ocarina player themselves, to get the feel of it, to understand the movements of the hands and how to coordinate that in the animation.
paragraphs.cn: 青沼：其中一个让我特别感兴趣的例子，是动画工作人员如何重现吹奏陶笛本身的动作。他们会研究真实的人吹奏的样子，有些人自己就是陶笛演奏者，以此体会吹奏的感觉，理解手部动作以及如何在动画中协调这些动作。

paragraphs.en: IGN: That's very cool. In the Ask the Developer , it was revealed that a “puppet show feel” and “analog practical effects films” were discussed during development. And I understand that in the original Ocarina of Time’s development, a field trip to a samurai stage show influenced the Z-targeting system. Did this anecdote come up at all during development of the remake?
paragraphs.cn: IGN：这很酷。在《Ask the Developer》中，有人透露开发过程中讨论过「木偶戏的感觉」和「采用实体特效的电影」。据我了解，在原版《塞尔达传说 时之笛》的开发过程中，一次观看武士舞台表演的实地考察影响了Z注视系统。开发重制版时，有没有提起过这件趣事？

paragraphs.en: Aonuma: You're referencing what's actually a very famous story within Nintendo during the development of the original Ocarina of Time. When people were approaching how to deal with the camera control during sword fighting scenes, before they came upon the idea of Z-targeting, they said, "Hey, let's go see an actual sword fight at this movie village theme park," I believe it was. And when they did so, they had this idea of like, "Okay, what if we fix the point that is orbiting around the target?" But I think more than that, what's important is how this relates to the general idea of looking at the real world and finding a motif that you can bring into the game that is helpful to bring an additional sense of realism or immersion or ease of play there. And certainly there are many examples of that in Ocarina of Time, both in the original and the remake. And we've even seen developers bringing some aspect of their own personal lives or everyday life into the experience of the game as well.
paragraphs.cn: 青沼：你提到的其实是任天堂内部一个非常有名的故事，发生在原版《塞尔达传说 时之笛》的开发期间。当大家在考虑如何处理剑斗场景中的视角控制时，在想到Z注视的点子之前，他们说：「嘿，我们去这个电影村主题公园看看真正的剑斗吧。」我记得是这样的。他们去了之后，产生了一个想法：「如果我们固定住围绕目标旋转的那个点，会怎么样？」但我认为更重要的是，这与观察现实世界、寻找可以带入游戏的主题这一总体思路有什么联系，而这种主题有助于为游戏增加真实感、沉浸感或操作上的便利。无论是原版还是重制版，《塞尔达传说 时之笛》中当然都有很多这样的例子。我们甚至还看到开发者将自己个人生活或日常生活中的某些方面带入游戏体验。

paragraphs.en: IGN: I'd like to ask, of all the quirky side characters in Hyrule, I'd love to hear each of your favorites. Not main characters or sages, but the townsfolk you only talk to a handful of times. My favorite is the magic bean seller. I love how his sales pitch gains this bravado as the “demand” for his product goes up.
paragraphs.cn: IGN：我想问，在海拉鲁所有古怪的配角中，两位各自最喜欢谁？不是主角或贤者，而是那些你只会和他们交谈几次的镇民。我最喜欢卖魔法豆的人。我喜欢随着他的商品「需求」上升，他的推销话术也越来越自夸。

paragraphs.en: Aonuma: So for me, I think one thing that stands out as a fun subcharacter is Ingo at Lon Lon Ranch, who is, you'll remember from the story, a bad guy, but not a real villain, let's say. And this was a chance to draw out a little bit more of his story and the experience of him, but more than anything, coming to the remake and coming back after the change of time saying like, "Oh, he's still alive." There's a kind of moment of joy for the player to feel that as well.
paragraphs.cn: 青沼：对我来说，我认为一个特别有趣的配角是Lon Lon Ranch的Ingo。你会记得在故事中，他是个坏人，但可以说不是真正的反派。这次是一个机会，能多展现一些他的故事和与他有关的体验。但最重要的是，在重制版中，时间变迁后回来看到他，会觉得：「哦，他还活着。」玩家也能感受到那样一瞬间的喜悦。

paragraphs.en: Fujibayashi: So for me, I think it's Dampe. Even in the original game, he kind of has this unique aura because he's obviously walking around in a graveyard, what is he doing there? And you assume that it's just going to be a conversation, then the mini game starts and then the reward turns out to be something actually really, really great. So it was a very unique and surprising encounter. So that really stuck with me.
paragraphs.cn: 藤林：对我来说，我想是Dampe。即使在原作中，他也有一种独特的气场，因为他显然是在墓地里走来走去，他在那里做什么呢？你以为只是一次对话，接着小游戏就开始了，而奖励原来是非常非常棒的东西。所以这是一次非常独特、令人惊讶的邂逅，给我留下了深刻印象。

paragraphs.en: IGN: Were there conversations during development about including Master Quest or any additional content from Ocarina of Time's original development that did not make it to the Nintendo 64 game?
paragraphs.cn: IGN：开发过程中有没有讨论过加入《Master Quest》，或是《塞尔达传说 时之笛》原始开发过程中未能进入任天堂64游戏的其他内容？

paragraphs.en: Aonuma: So certainly anytime that we release a game, if there's an opportunity for the devs to consider what might come in the future, we want to leave that possibility open to them and support their interests. But I don't think that we would announce anything specific at this time. But one thing that is a new element that I think is interesting to bring up is the Hall of Fallen Foes, which you would have not remembered from the original Ocarina of Time, but having defeated enemies in the world, you can then see models of them, see descriptions, and even recreate some boss battles.
paragraphs.cn: 青沼：当然，每当我们推出一款游戏，如果开发者有机会考虑未来可能出现的东西，我们都希望为他们保留这种可能性，并支持他们的兴趣。但我不认为我们目前会公布任何具体内容。不过，有一个新要素我认为值得一提，那就是Hall of Fallen Foes，你不会记得原版《塞尔达传说 时之笛》中有这个地方。在世界中击败敌人后，你可以在那里看到他们的模型和说明，甚至可以重现一些首领战。

paragraphs.en: IGN: I'd like to wrap up asking a couple of questions about Zelda's 40th anniversary as a whole. In playing Ocarina of Time, I came to a similar realization as Mr. Fujibayashi, that Zelda games are about exploration and discovery no matter top down, 3D, open air, whatever form they take. Looking back on the last 40 years of The Legend of Zelda, which you've both been a significant part of, what's the biggest reflection about the series that's been on your mind?
paragraphs.cn: IGN：最后我想问几个关于《塞尔达传说》40周年整体的问题。在游玩《塞尔达传说 时之笛》时，我得出了与藤林先生类似的认识：无论是俯视视角、3D、开放式，还是其他什么形式，《塞尔达传说》游戏的主题都是探索与发现。回顾《塞尔达传说》过去的40年，两位都是其中重要的一部分，你们对这个系列最深刻的感想是什么？

paragraphs.en: Aonuma: So when we talk about what makes the core of the Zelda experience, there's one anecdote that I do want to relate where Mr. Miyamoto came to me late at night and he said, "Hey, Mr. Aonuma, you know you can't really cut a wooden crate with a sword, right?" And I was thinking to myself like, "Why are you coming to me when you're so busy with something like this?" But I think that really goes to the core experience of Zelda style gameplay where you want to see something that is relatable from real life. You have the predictability of how things might work in the real world and you can use that to intuitively consider what might happen in the game. There's a lot of satisfaction that comes from that. Even being able to slice a sign and then see the pieces float away in the water, that can be really satisfying for people, knowing that there are consequences to your actions that are predictable from your own real world experience and might lead you to think, "Oh, what else could I do in this game that I could do in the real world and would be predictable?" So anytime you can create that kind of experience for the player, I think it has a real impact in terms of bringing them into thinking about their actions in the game.
paragraphs.cn: 青沼：说到什么构成了《塞尔达传说》体验的核心，有一件趣事我确实想讲一讲。有一天深夜，宫本先生来找我说：「嘿，青沼先生，你知道现实中用剑是劈不开木箱的吧？」我心里想：「你这么忙，为什么还要因为这种事来找我？」但我认为这确实触及了《塞尔达传说》式玩法的核心体验：你希望看到一些能与现实生活联系起来的东西。你可以根据事物在现实世界中可能如何运作作出预测，并借此直观地思考游戏中可能发生什么。这会带来很大的满足感。即使只是能够劈开一块告示牌，然后看到碎片在水中漂走，也能让人感到非常满足：你知道自己的行为会产生可以根据现实经验预测的后果，这可能会让你想：「哦，在这款游戏中，我还能做些什么现实中能做、结果也可以预测的事？」因此，我认为每当你能为玩家创造这样的体验，就能切实地促使他们思考自己在游戏中的行为。

paragraphs.en: Lots of things that you can do certainly in recent games, if we consider Breath of the Wild and Tears of the Kingdom, the physics system allows you to recreate so many kinds of interactions in the world that maybe you might be able to do in the real world as well. When we connect that to another part of the core of the Zelda franchise, which is exploration and discovery, you have this cycle of you look for a thing, you think about how to address the thing, you make a discovery, and then you think about where to go from there. And I think those are the values that all link together to support this sense of what is the essence of The Legend of Zelda franchise.
paragraphs.cn: 在近期的游戏中，当然有很多事情可以做。如果以《旷野之息》和《王国之泪》为例，物理系统让你能够在游戏世界中重现许多种也许在现实世界中也能做到的互动。当我们把这一点与《塞尔达传说》系列核心的另一部分——探索与发现——联系起来时，就会形成这样一个循环：你寻找某个东西，思考如何应对它，有所发现，然后思考接下来该去哪里。我认为，这些价值观相互联系，共同支撑着人们对《塞尔达传说》系列本质的认识。

paragraphs.en: IGN: Besides Ocarina of Time, which Zelda game is the most special to each of you?
paragraphs.cn: IGN：除了《塞尔达传说 时之笛》，哪款《塞尔达传说》游戏对两位各自来说最特别？

paragraphs.en: Aonuma: So special, it's interesting. Let me see. Since we've been talking about the development of Ocarina of Time, maybe it's good to acknowledge the source of some of the ideas that I brought to the development of that project. And for me, this would be The Legen
paragraphs.cn: 青沼：最特别，很有意思。让我想想。既然我们一直在谈论《塞尔达传说 时之笛》的开发，或许可以说一说我为那个项目的开发带去的一些想法的来源。对我来说，这会是《The Legen》
